step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a frequency comparator latch typically used in VCO-based ADCs. It compares the frequencies of two input clocks (CLKP and CLKN) by using them to drive switched-capacitor networks that discharge internal integration nodes (N1, N3). A cross-coupled latch resolves the state based on which node discharges faster, while CLKN also acts as an asymmetric reset signal via XM11.

paper_reference.title: A 0.45V 100-Channel Neural-Recording IC with Sub-μW/Channel Consumption in 0.18μm CMOS

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the comparator during continuous clocking

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C_tot * VDD^2 * f_clk. With VDD=1.8V, C_tot ≈ 50fF, and f=100MHz, P ≈ 50e-15 * 1.8^2 * 100e6 = 16.2μW
sky130_expected.reasoning: Power will be significantly higher than the paper's reported sub-μW value because we are simulating at VDD=1.8V instead of 0.45V, and power scales quadratically with VDD.

v_n1_drop.description: Minimum voltage reached on the integration node N1 due to the switched-capacitor discharge

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the voltage divider between the pull-up PMOS (XML7) R_ON and the equivalent SC resistance (1/(f*C)). V_N1 ≈ VDD * R_SC / (R_ON + R_SC)
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the input frequency of CLKP. Higher frequencies will cause a larger voltage drop.

reset_delay.description: Time from CLKN falling edge to N11 falling edge (reset state)

sky130_expected.calculation: t_d = C_N11 * VDD / I_discharge. With C_N11 ≈ 10fF and I ≈ 1mA, t_d ≈ 18ps
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard logic gate delay for SKY130 at 1.8V.

output_swing.description: Maximum voltage swing of the combined output node VOUT

sky130_expected.calculation: VOUT is driven by PMOS pass transistors connected to N5 and N11, which swing rail-to-rail.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At VDD=1.8V, the output should reach very close to the supply rail.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power consumption, integration node voltage drops, and reset delay by applying a 10MHz reference clock to CLKN and a 100MHz variable clock to CLKP.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Frequency Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xml8=5u L_xml8=0.5u
.param W_xmr5=5u L_xmr5=0.5u
.param W_xmr6=5u L_xmr6=0.5u
.param W_xml7=5u L_xml7=0.5u
.param W_xmr3=5u L_xmr3=0.5u
.param W_xml3=5u L_xml3=0.5u
.param W_xml1=5u L_xml1=0.5u
.param W_xmr8=5u L_xmr8=0.5u
.param W_xmr2=5u L_xmr2=0.5u
.param W_xml5=5u L_xml5=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xml2=5u L_xml2=0.5u
.param W_xmr4=5u L_xmr4=0.5u
.param W_xml4=5u L_xml4=0.5u
.param W_xml6=5u L_xml6=0.5u
.param W_xml9=5u L_xml9=0.5u
.param W_xmr7=5u L_xmr7=0.5u
.param W_xmr9=5u L_xmr9=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0

* Clocks: CLKN is reset/reference (10MHz), CLKP is fast input (100MHz)
VCLKP CLKP 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 4.9n 10n)
VCLKN CLKN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)

* DUT
XML8 N5 N11 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xml8} w={W_xml8}
XMR5 N8 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmr5} w={W_xmr5}
XMR6 N11 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmr6} w={W_xmr6}
XML7 N1 N11 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xml7} w={W_xml7}
XMR3 N12 CLKN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmr3} w={W_xmr3}
XML3 N14 CLKP GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xml3} w={W_xml3}
XML1 N14 CLKP GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xml1} w={W_xml1}
XMR8 N11 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmr8} w={W_xmr8}
XMR2 N12 CLKN N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmr2} w={W_xmr2}
XML5 N13 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xml5} w={W_xml5}
XM11 N8 CLKN N11 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XML2 N14 CLKP N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xml2} w={W_xml2}
XMR4 N8 N3 N11 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmr4} w={W_xmr4}
XML4 N13 N1 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xml4} w={W_xml4}
XML6 N5 N13 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xml6} w={W_xml6}
XML9 VOUT N11 N5 N5 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xml9} w={W_xml9}
XMR7 N3 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmr7} w={W_xmr7}
XMR9 VOUT N5 N11 N11 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmr9} w={W_xmr9}

* Load for VOUT to prevent floating states
C_vout VOUT 0 10f
R_vout VOUT 0 100MEG

.control
tran 100p 200n

* Measure Power
meas tran pwr avg i(VVDD)
let power_uw = -pwr * 1.8 * 1e6
print power_uw

* Measure Integration Node Drops
meas tran v_n1_min min v(N1)
meas tran v_n3_min min v(N3)

* Measure Output Swing
meas tran v_out_max max v(VOUT)
meas tran v_out_min min v(VOUT)

* Measure Reset Delay
meas tran delay_reset trig v(CLKN) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N11) val=0.9 fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
